result.title: A Well-Posed Fourth-Order Navier-Stokes Model for Image Inpainting: Theory, Order Selection, and Stripe Decomposition
result.summary: The Navier-Stokes (NS) inpainting model of Bertalmío, Bertozzi and Sapiro is the only transport-type paradigm among PDE-based methods, yet it has never received a systematic higher-order extension. We show that the obvious fourth-order correction is ill-posed, and we construct the corrected, well-posed model. In the vorticity-streamfunction formulation we add a gated fourth-order term whose sign is decisive: the backward form is a Perona-Malik-type anti-diffusion, Hadamard ill-posed and consistently harmful in experiments, whereas the forward form is uniformly parabolic, energy-stable and consistently beneficial. An order-dissipation principle, stating that odd orders are dispersive and even orders dissipative, singles out the fourth order as the lowest admissible one. Large missing blocks pose a separate problem, because the correction gate stays silent there; we answer it with stripe decomposition, a Telea base fill followed by interleaved slit-wise NS passes, which converts block damage into the structural-slit regime where the model excels. The device is base-agnostic, and its gains add to those of the forward correction. On three datasets, namely BSDS500, DIV2K and a classical Chinese painting benchmark, and on three damage types, namely cracks, blocks and text occlusion, the training-free model beats every classical baseline on every sample of structure-dominated damage, gains +1.02 dB PSNR over Telea on the full 42-image painting test set with a 42/42 per-sample win rate, matches the strongest recent PDE solvers within 0.4 dB while attaining the best perceptual quality of the entire PDE family, and runs at 4-16 s per image on a consumer GPU.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为 Bertalmío–Bertozzi–Sapiro 的 Navier-Stokes 图像修复模型构造良定的四阶扩展：在涡量-流函数形式下加入带门控的四阶项，论证反向形式为 Hadamard 不适定且有害、正向形式一致抛物且能量稳定，并给出奇阶色散/偶阶耗散的阶数-耗散原则；另以 Telea 底填加交错狭缝 NS 迭代处理大块缺失。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作本身与 VLM 推理无直接关联，但其对迭代状态更新的适定性/能量稳定性判别（正向稳、反向反扩散发散）以及门控失效后改用结构性分块填充的思路，或可作为 latent 状态循环更新稳定性与缺失证据分阶段补全的类比线索，需核查其可迁移性。
